outcome: Cord plasma fatty acid binding protein 4 (FABP4) concentrations
Cord plasma total and high-molecular-weight adiponectin concentrations
cohort: 153 pairs of newborns from the Shanghai Birth Cohort, with one newborn in each pair exposed to GDM and the other to a euglycemic pregnancy, matched by infant sex and gestational age at delivery
finding: GDM was associated with higher cord plasma FABP4 and estradiol concentrations in male newborns, but not in female newborns.
